endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: king_county_tolt_macdonald_snoqualmie_launch_aerial_20260918 tolt-macdonald-park-snoqualmie-boat-launch: King County identifies Tolt-MacDonald Park as a public park with a boat launch, and its park map includes a boat-launch facility. The named Snoqualmie River Boat Launch map feature is linked to King County park information; current aerial imagery places that ramp on the Snoqualmie River bank at 47.6385904,-121.9263098. The previous route point was about 393 feet from the matched Snoqualmie flowline and 282 feet from mapped water. This replacement has approximately 50-foot uncertainty and is not a surveyed King County coordinate.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the exact named authoritative water-entry control (king_county_tolt_macdonald_snoqualmie_launch_aerial_20260918 tolt-macdonald-park-snoqualmie-boat-launch) on Snoqualmie River; the 120 ft named-flowline offset reflects incomplete or generalized NHD coverage, not a proposed coordinate move.
